acceptance_criteria: cargo build --bin stoa-rnews succeeds; E2E test passes; cargo test -p stoa-transit -- rnews_ingest passes
description:
What: Add the stoa-rnews binary target to crates/transit/Cargo.toml and implement src/rnews_main.rs — the full wiring entry point.
Files: crates/transit/Cargo.toml (add [[bin]] stanza); new crates/transit/src/rnews_main.rs

Algorithm for Cargo.toml:
1. Add under existing [[bin]] stanza for stoa-transit:
   [[bin]]
   name = "stoa-rnews"
   path = "src/rnews_main.rs"

Algorithm for rnews_main.rs:
1. Parse CLI: --config <path> required, --check flag optional
2. Call RnewsConfig::from_file(path); on error: eprintln + exit(1)
3. Init tracing-subscriber (same pattern as transit main.rs lines 318–340)
4. sqlx::any::install_default_drivers() — MUST be before any pool open
5. Run migrations:
   - stoa_core::migrations::run_migrations(&config.database.core_url).await
   - stoa_transit::migrations::run_migrations(&config.database.url).await
   Both must succeed or exit(1) with the error.
6. Open pools:
   - core_pool: try_open_any_pool(&config.database.core_url, 3).await
   - transit_pool: try_open_any_pool(&config.database.url, 3).await
7. Build IPFS store: stoa_transit::peering::pipeline::build_store(&config_as_transit_config).await
   Note: build_store takes &transit::config::Config. RnewsConfig must either convert to Config for this call, or build_store must be refactored to take only &BackendConfig. Choose the simpler: add a From<&RnewsConfig> impl that produces a minimal Config with only the backend field populated. Mark other required fields with their defaults.
8. Construct: MsgIdMap::new(core_pool.clone()), SqliteLogStorage::new(core_pool.clone())
9. Load signing key:
   - If config.operator.signing_key_path is set: read file, parse Ed25519 key bytes, construct SigningKey
   - If absent: generate ephemeral key with rand_core::OsRng (log a warning: ephemeral key; articles will not be re-verifiable)
10. Construct HlcClock: load_hlc_checkpoint(&transit_pool).await; construct with ensure_instance_node_id(...)
11. If --check: print "config OK" and exit 0.
12. Read all of stdin into Vec<u8>:
    - use std::io::Read; let mut stdin_bytes = Vec::new(); io::stdin().read_to_end(&mut stdin_bytes)?
    - Cap: if stdin_bytes.len() > MAX_BATCH_DECOMPRESSED_BYTES: eprintln!(...) + exit(1)
      (A raw uncompressed batch larger than 50 MiB is already suspicious)
13. Parse: let articles = parse_rnews_batch(&stdin_bytes). On Err: log + exit(1).
14. For each article in articles:
    a. Extract envelope message_id from article bytes: use extract_message_id_bytes(&article) (from import/reindex.rs; make it pub if needed)
    b. If missing: log warn "article missing Message-ID, skipping"; continue
    c. let result = check_ingest(&envelope_msgid, &article, &msgid_map).await
    d. Match result:
       - Accepted: call run_pipeline(&article, &ipfs, &msgid_map, &log_storage, &transit_pool, ctx).await
         On Ok: log info cid+groups; increment accepted counter
         On Err(PipelineError::Permanent(msg)): log warn; increment rejected counter
         On Err(PipelineError::Transient(msg)): log error; increment transient_error counter; exit(1) after loop? No — log and continue (uucico should not retry for transient failures in individual articles)
       - Duplicate: log debug; increment duplicate counter
       - Rejected(msg): log warn; increment rejected counter
       - TransientError(msg): log error; increment transient_error counter
    e. Close pools.
15. Log summary: info!(accepted, duplicates, rejected, transient_errors, total = articles.len(), "stoa-rnews batch complete")
16. Exit 0 (even if some articles rejected — UUCP semantics: batch was processed, not partially)

Defensive rules:
- No unwrap() in main path; all errors go to eprintln!() + exit(1) or logged + continue
- stdin_bytes cap at MAX_BATCH_DECOMPRESSED_BYTES before parse_rnews_batch (prevents OOM before decompression check fires)
- Signing key: if read from file fails, exit(1) with error; do NOT fall back to ephemeral silently without a config flag
- No key material logged (signing key bytes, any DKIM config)
- PipelineCtx.verify_store = None (skip signature recording for rnews ingress — can be enabled later)
- PipelineCtx.dkim_auth = None
- PipelineCtx.group_filter = config.groups.as_ref().map(|g| g.filter()).unwrap_or(None)

Tests: integration test in crates/transit/tests/rnews_ingest.rs:
- test_rnews_ingest_two_articles_e2e:
  1. Construct a minimal valid 2-article batch (hand-crafted bytes matching the SPEC test vector from research)
  2. Open an in-memory or temp SQLite DB, run migrations
  3. Open a MemIpfsStore
  4. Call parse_rnews_batch on the batch bytes
  5. For each article: check_ingest + run_pipeline against the temp stores
  6. Assert both articles returned PipelineResult with valid CIDs
  7. Assert MsgIdMap contains both message IDs
  Oracle: the CIDs are computed from the article bytes by the production CID derivation code; verify they are deterministic by running twice and comparing (the oracle is content-addressing consistency, not a pre-computed vector)
title: [[bin]] stoa-rnews target and rnews_main.rs entry point
